known_limitations: Inventory completeness is bounded to threads accessible or discoverable to the authenticated account at capture.
Attachment-CDN path IDs are retained by collectors only as unverified metadata and are never accepted here as exact thread identity.

scope.discovery_method: Authenticated Discord UI applicability plus active and discoverable-archive passes for every one of the 38 top-level parents
scope.remaining_limitation: Deleted, inaccessible, or no-longer-discoverable threads remain outside the provable authenticated-account scope.

checks.name: collection_drift_final_audit_passed
checks.note: A final release requires the independent collection-drift audit to resolve every total-drift/replacement chain with zero unresolved or orphan quarantined partials.

checks.name: guild_wide_date_coverage
checks.note: Channel-complete inventory coverage may also satisfy release, but guild-wide coverage is independently reported.

checks.name: requested_window_elapsed_at_cutoff
checks.note: July 20 cannot be certified as a full Central-local day before July 21 05:00Z.

checks.name: duplicate_occurrences_preserved
checks.expected: All occurrences remain available to the validator.

checks.name: content_edit_variants_resolved
checks.note: A differing message body is an edit only when capture chronology or edited_at establishes version order.

checks.name: reply_context_has_explicit_target
checks.note: Adjacent or visible reply text must not be treated as an answered Q&A without an explicit target ID. Discord's exact unloaded, attachment, sticker, voice-message, and Dyno no-ID states remain documented, unresolved context and are never linked as answered Q&A.

checks.name: reply_resolution_status_boolean_consistent
checks.note: A documented no-ID status is accepted only when the exact Discord widget evidence matches the enumerated status and the documentation boolean is true. Unknown contexts remain unresolved with false.

checks.name: reply_targets_have_owned_exact_scope
checks.note: Accepted targets come from allowlisted row-owned reply-context content, ARIA, data-list/data-message, or permalink evidence with exact scope and an exact Discord target permalink. Preview-only links or text are context, never resolved reply evidence.

checks.name: attachment_archive_terminal_coverage
checks.note: Every discovered Discord-owned attachment requires downloaded bytes with SHA-256 when available, or a substantiated terminal unavailable record. Terminal failed records remain degraded and block literal release.

checks.name: attachment_has_single_owner
checks.note: Reply-preview attachment references must be stored separately from message-owned attachments.

checks.name: attachment_ownership_evidence_exact
checks.note: Every Discord CDN row must be explicitly classified as owned-exact or non-owned-exact.

checks.name: sqlite_database_supplied
checks.expected: path to the release SQLite database

checks.name: relevance_policy_artifacts_stable_during_validation
checks.note: Includes the relevance plan, Discord-derived vocabulary sources, and the orchestrator progress/review manifest and final collection-drift audit when supplied.

limitations: Completeness is limited to containers visible to the authenticated Discord account at inventory time.
Messages deleted before collection and inaccessible private channels cannot be independently recovered.
An edited flag without edited_at or ordered capture timestamps cannot reconstruct edit history.
Discord post time is not assumed to equal the market setup time discussed in a message.
External links appearing inside Discord messages are retained as text but are not external evidence.
Terminal unavailable Discord attachments remain explicit media gaps; terminal failed rows are degraded and block literal release.
Chart-dependent claims remain unresolved unless a complete/partial extraction with a verified local artifact and exact provenance exists.
All 16 nonempty channels require message-complete capture; supplemental targeted artifacts never satisfy or weaken that requirement.
